video_title: Media Availability: Head Coach Brian Keefe and Trae Young | 11.20.26

quotes.speaker: Brian Keefe
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Keefe on the importance of cup games for team development
quotes.excerpt: These cup games are important for us. Playing these type of games to grow in these games.
quotes.quote: This year was for this. These cup games are important for us. Playing these type of games to grow in these games, to the level of intensity and the adjustments that are needed to sometimes winning games like this, this is a great learning experience for us.
quotes.social_post: Brian Keefe says these cup games are a great learning experience for the Wizards as the team works to grow in intensity and adjust to high stakes moments

structured.context: Head coach Brian Keefe discusses the importance of NBA Cup games for the team's development.

quotes.speaker: Brian Keefe
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Keefe credits defensive adjustments for second-half success
quotes.excerpt: The biggest difference obviously was what we did in the second half defensively.
quotes.quote: The biggest difference obviously was what we did in the second half defensively. They had nine points in the third quarter, I think 34 for the whole half. Our guys really ratcheted it up, focused on the things that we talked about at halftime, and they were able to accomplish that.
quotes.social_post: Brian Keefe credits a defensive mindset shift at halftime for the Wizards holding their opponent to just 34 points in the second half

structured.context: Brian Keefe explains the defensive adjustments made at halftime that led to a successful second half.

quotes.speaker: Brian Keefe
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Keefe on team response to defensive standards
quotes.excerpt: The guys knew that we were up to our standard and they wanted to make a difference.
quotes.quote: The guys knew that we were up to our standard and they wanted to make a difference, and they made a difference pretty quickly. They had four transition points. We won that game 24 to 4. We can get our defense set, we can get back, we should be hard to score on, and I thought our guys made a great mindset shift at the half.
quotes.social_post: Brian Keefe on the defensive turnaround against transition points: We can get our defense set, we can get back, we should be hard to score on

structured.context: Brian Keefe reflects on the team's defensive mindset shift during the game.

quotes.speaker: Brian Keefe
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Keefe praises Trae Young's all-around impact
quotes.excerpt: This is what we're seeing, the evolutionary growth that we already knew that we had.
quotes.quote: This is what we're seeing, the evolutionary growth that we already knew that we had is this guy's an impact player all over the court. Two ends, guarding their best players, finishing possessions, rebounding, I think he had a couple steals. You saw the assists tonight, his ability to get into the paint and make plays for himself and others, and this is just the start.
quotes.social_post: Brian Keefe is seeing evolutionary growth in Trae Young, calling him an impact player on both ends of the floor who is guarding the best players and finishing possessions

structured.context: Brian Keefe praises Trae Young for his all-around impact on both ends of the court.

quotes.speaker: Brian Keefe
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Keefe on Trae Young's ability to impact games despite shooting
quotes.excerpt: I thought he impacted the game with his defense, specifically in the second half.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified reporter
text_blocks.text: You're going to have nights and that's what we talked about, you can control things. You're not always going to shoot well, but how can you impact the game?

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Keefe
text_blocks.text: I thought he impacted the game with his defense, specifically in the second half. He got a turnover right away, forced a jump ball. His playmaking, he's going to draw people, he's going to draw crowds, but his overall presence in the court just helps us.

quotes.social_post: Brian Keefe on Trae Young: You are not always going to shoot well, but how can you impact the game? I thought he impacted the game with his defense

structured.context: Brian Keefe discusses how Trae Young impacts the game through defense and playmaking even when his shot is not falling.

quotes.speaker: Brian Keefe
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Keefe on Trae Young's role as an offensive anchor
quotes.excerpt: He's just our anchor on both ends, but he really steadied us when we needed him on offense.
quotes.quote: He can steady us. We can get him baskets around the rim, but he played with great force tonight. He was finishing things around the paint, he obviously offensive rebounds. He's just our anchor on both ends, but he really steadied us when we needed him on offense.
quotes.social_post: Brian Keefe calls Trae Young the anchor for the Wizards on both ends of the floor, noting his ability to steady the offense even when he is not scoring

structured.context: Brian Keefe describes Trae Young's role as an offensive anchor for the team.

quotes.speaker: Trae Young
quotes.summary_phrase: Trae Young on the importance of big state games
quotes.excerpt: Playing in big state games is important for this team.
quotes.quote: I mean, I think playing in big state games is important for this team and getting us in playing in those type of games is important for us. So us winning today was important for us and coming into the game, we had the right mindset and I just found a way to get a win.
quotes.social_post: Trae Young says the Wizards had the right mindset coming into today and found a way to get a win in a big game

structured.context: Trae Young comments on the importance of winning high-stakes games for the team's growth.

quotes.speaker: Trae Young
quotes.summary_phrase: Trae Young on AJ Dybantsa's development and confidence
quotes.excerpt: It's very important that he leads his mark. I just wanted to give him as much confidence.
quotes.quote: It's very important that he leads his mark. I mean as a rookie and for me as one of his vets, I just wanted to give him as much confidence and give him as much freedom out there with the ball and just find him in transition and let him bring it up sometimes and play with it. So he's been doing great for us and he's going to continue to get better and put on a show for everybody.
quotes.social_post: Trae Young on rookie AJ Dybantsa: I just wanted to give him as much confidence and give him as much freedom out there with the ball and let him bring it up sometimes

structured.context: Trae Young discusses his role in mentoring rookie teammate AJ Dybantsa.

quotes.speaker: Trae Young
quotes.summary_phrase: Trae Young on Anthony Davis's performance in his hometown
quotes.excerpt: He's been doing that for years and it's something that a lot of people have seen.
quotes.quote: I mean that's nothing new. He's been doing that for years and it's something that a lot of people have seen from a distance and for us Wizards fans and teammates, we get to see it up close. It's very special and to be a part of it, he makes our lives easier and for me as a point guard trying to get him the ball as much as possible, especially when he has it going like that.
quotes.social_post: Trae Young on playing with Anthony Davis: He makes our lives easier and for me as a point guard trying to get him the ball as much as possible, especially when he has it going like that

structured.context: Trae Young praises teammate Anthony Davis for his consistent performance and impact on the floor.

quotes.speaker: Trae Young
quotes.summary_phrase: Trae Young on building momentum after back-to-back wins
quotes.excerpt: Just not being satisfied with what we've done in these last two games.
quotes.quote: Just not being satisfied with what we've done in these last two games. Obviously, getting two wins is not easy in this league, especially back-to-back, but we have a good enough team to do that and also build off that. For me, that's all that matters is getting these wins and now we get to go back home and we need to do a better job of protecting home court.
quotes.social_post: Trae Young says the Wizards are not satisfied with back to back wins and need to do a better job of protecting home court

structured.context: Trae Young emphasizes the need to build momentum and protect home court after recent wins.
